title: 100% Electric Ferry Crossing | Fully Charged 4k
summary: Fully Charged rides a 100% battery-electric ferry across the 4 km strait between Helsingborg, Sweden and Helsingør, Denmark. The ferry crosses up to 46 times a day and charges for a few minutes at each side. The video shows the charging setup, including the robot arm that couples the charger.
why: HN commenters cite it as a concrete, working example of large-battery electric shipping with fast automated charging.

quote.text: I recently saw this Fully Charged video about a short, but very frequent, ferry crossing that is now fully electric
